$comment: Shared defaults. Merged with conf/<exchange>.<mode>.json by tools/run_bot.py. dry_run here is the safe default; only an explicit live config plus ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING can change it.
$comment_timeframe: No 'timeframe' key on purpose. Freqtrade's config takes precedence over the strategy attribute, so setting it here would silently force every strategy onto the same timeframe regardless of what it declares (and of what its model was trained on). Each strategy sets its own.

entry_pricing.$comment: price_side 'other' crosses the spread rather than joining the book. It fills more like a market order, which is the conservative assumption for a signal-driven strategy and keeps backtest fills closer to reality.

$comment_protections: Protections live on the strategy class (see strategies/common/risk_manager.py). Freqtrade 2026.7 raises ConfigurationError for a `protections` key in the config: it is deprecated there.
$comment_telegram: No 'telegram' block on purpose. Freqtrade's schema requires token and chat_id whenever the block is present, and ProjectChimera sends its own notifications through chimera.notify instead. Freqtrade's built-in Telegram stays off by default.
$comment_api_server: No 'api_server' block on purpose. The REST API is off by default; enabling it opens a control plane that can start, stop and force-enter trades.

risk.$comment: Consumed by chimera.risk.RiskEngine via strategies/common/risk_manager.py. Unknown keys are ignored.
